name: Three-way match payment pack
document: one page from a three-way match payment pack (purchase order, vendor invoice and receiving report) for a single purchase, which may be a scan, fax or phone photo

fields.label: PO number
fields.note: The purchase order reference, labelled 'PO number', 'Your PO' or 'Against PO' depending on the page. Do not use the invoice number in the invoice header, which is a different number.

fields.label: Vendor / supplier name
fields.note: The supplier: labelled 'Vendor' on the purchase order and receiving report, or the company name in the invoice header. Do not use the buyer name (Harlow Manufacturing) that appears as 'Bill to' or in page headers.

fields.label: Buyer name
fields.note: The buying company: 'Bill to' on the invoice, or the company in the small header on the purchase order and receiving report. Do not swap with the vendor/supplier name.

fields.label: Vendor bank account number
fields.note: The vendor's bank account: 'Vendor bank account on file' on the purchase order or 'Account:' under 'Remit payment to' on the invoice. Do not use the routing number printed directly below/next to it; the account here is the shorter number.

fields.label: Vendor bank routing number
fields.note: The bank routing number: 'Routing number on file' on the purchase order or 'Routing:' under 'Remit payment to' on the invoice. Do not use the account number printed directly above/next to it; the routing number here is the longer, leading-zero number.

fields.label: Total amount / amount due
fields.note: The stack total: 'Order total' on the purchase order or 'Amount due' on the invoice, printed below the line table. Do not use any single line amount/total from inside the table, and it does not appear on the receiving report.

tables.label: Line items ordered, invoiced and received

columns.label: Item / description
columns.note: First column naming the row, headed 'Item' or 'Description'; copy the full description including sizes/pack details.

columns.label: Quantity
columns.note: Headed 'Qty', 'Quantity' or 'Qty received'; the same quantity should appear on the purchase order, invoice and receiving report for that item.

columns.label: Unit price
columns.note: Headed 'Unit price' or 'Price' on the purchase order and invoice; leave blank on the receiving report, which has no prices.

columns.label: Line amount
columns.note: Headed 'Amount' or 'Line total' for that row only; leave blank on the receiving report. Do not use the order total/amount due below the table.

columns.label: Condition
columns.note: Headed 'Condition' on the receiving report only (e.g. OK); leave blank on the purchase order and invoice, which have no condition column.

readers.name: Full reader
readers.instruction: Read every field and every line-item row visible on this page, including bank details and totals. Ignore document type, page titles, per-document dates and the invoice number.

readers.name: Parties and PO specialist
readers.instruction: Read only the PO number, vendor/supplier name and buyer name from the header area, carefully not swapping vendor and buyer. Ignore bank details, totals, dates, invoice number and the line-item table.

readers.name: Payment and lines specialist
readers.instruction: Read the vendor bank account, routing number, total amount and all line-item rows, keeping account and routing numbers distinct and leaving price/amount blank where a page has none. Ignore party names, dates, invoice number and any received-by signature text.

checks.message: The pack must contain at least one complete line item to match ordering, invoicing and receiving before payment.
